title: Enhance Olya App Architecture to Reflect AI/ML Vision Within Platform Constraints

requirements.text: Redesign the ASR input area in TranscriptInput to visually represent a Whisper-style speech-to-text pipeline: show a waveform animation when the microphone is active, label the ASR engine selector clearly as 'ASR Engine (Whisper / Web Speech / DeepSpeech)', and display a live transcription confidence indicator alongside the interim transcript text.

quotes: update the app's architecture to better reflect this vision within the platform's constraints

acceptanceCriteria: Microphone button shows animated waveform when recording is active
ASR engine selector is labeled with Whisper, Web Speech, and DeepSpeech options
A simulated confidence percentage (e.g., 94%) is shown alongside interim transcript text
Visual design communicates a pipeline stage (input → transcription)

requirements.text: Upgrade the SemanticAnalysisPanel and EmotionIntentPanel to visually represent BERT/RoBERTa-style NLP processing: display a 'Model' label (e.g., 'NLP: BERT/RoBERTa'), show token-level keyword highlights with confidence scores, render sentiment as a signed score with directional bar (negative to positive), and display intent classification with top-3 ranked intents and probability bars.
acceptanceCriteria: Panel header clearly labels the model as 'NLP: BERT / RoBERTa'
Keywords are highlighted with individual confidence scores
Sentiment bar spans negative to positive with a numeric score
Top-3 intents shown with probability bars adding to ~100%
Emotion panel header labels the model as 'Emotion & Intent: Fine-tuned Transformer'

requirements.text: Enhance the BeliefStatePanel to visually represent a Knowledge Graph + Bayesian Network: render speaker nodes as graph nodes connected by labeled edges (e.g., 'Trust', 'Conflict', 'Agreement'), display Bayesian confidence percentages on each node, and show a 'Belief Modeling: KG + Bayesian Networks' panel label. Use the existing canvas-based visualization as the foundation.

quotes: Belief Modeling: Knowledge Graph + Bayesian Networks

acceptanceCriteria: Panel header reads 'Belief Modeling: KG + Bayesian Networks'
Speaker nodes are connected by directional labeled edges
Each node displays a Bayesian confidence percentage
Graph updates as new transcript entries are added

requirements.text: Upgrade the StrategyEnginePanel to visually represent an LLM + Reinforcement Learning pipeline: add a 'Strategy Engine: LLaMA + RL' panel label, display each recommended strategy with an RL reward score and rank badge, show a 'Policy Update' indicator that animates briefly when new strategies are computed, and include a simulated 'Exploration vs. Exploitation' ratio bar.
acceptanceCriteria: Panel header reads 'Strategy Engine: LLaMA + RL'
Each strategy recommendation shows an RL reward score and rank
A 'Policy Update' animation triggers when strategies are recalculated
Exploration vs. Exploitation ratio bar is displayed

requirements.text: Upgrade the EthicsBadge and SafetyQualityPanel to visually represent a dedicated Ethics & Bias Detection module: add an 'Ethics: Bias & Toxicity Detection' label, display a breakdown of detected bias categories (gender, racial, socioeconomic) with severity bars, show a toxicity score gauge (0–100), and add a 'Hallucination Risk' indicator sourced from the existing hallucinationGuard utility.
acceptanceCriteria: Ethics panel/badge is labeled 'Ethics: Bias & Toxicity Detection'
Bias category breakdown shows gender, racial, and socioeconomic bars
Toxicity score is displayed as a gauge from 0 to 100
Hallucination Risk indicator appears using hallucinationGuard output

requirements.text: Update the AppHeader to display the full AI pipeline stack as a status ribbon: show labeled status chips for ASR, NLP, Emotion & Intent, Belief Modeling, Strategy Engine, and Ethics — each chip showing active/inactive state with the model name (e.g., 'ASR: Whisper ✓', 'NLP: BERT ✓'). Replace the current ASR and NLP/Ethics badges with this expanded pipeline ribbon.

quotes: update the app's architecture to better reflect this vision within the platform's constraints

acceptanceCriteria: Header shows chips for all 6 pipeline stages
Each chip displays the model name and active/inactive status
Chips update state reactively as the session processes input
Responsive layout collapses chips gracefully on smaller screens

requirements.text: Update the Dashboard layout to visually communicate a sequential AI processing pipeline: arrange panels in a logical flow order — Transcript Input (ASR) → Emotion & Intent → Semantic / NLP → Belief State (KG) → Strategy Engine (RL) → Ethics / Safety — with subtle connecting flow indicators (arrows or step numbers) between panel sections to communicate data flow.

quotes: update the app's architecture to better reflect this vision within the platform's constraints

acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard panels are ordered to reflect the AI pipeline sequence
Visual connectors (arrows or step numbers) appear between panel sections
Layout remains responsive and usable on standard desktop widths
Each panel section is visually distinct with its pipeline stage label

requirements.text: Update the UserManual page (frontend/src/pages/UserManual.tsx) to document the AI pipeline architecture: add a dedicated 'Architecture Overview' section describing each pipeline stage (ASR, NLP, Emotion & Intent, Belief Modeling, Strategy Engine, Ethics) with its simulated model name, purpose, and how it processes data within the platform. Use existing Section and InfoBox components.

quotes: update the app's architecture to better reflect this vision within the platform's constraints

acceptanceCriteria: UserManual has an 'Architecture Overview' section in the table of contents
Each of the 6 pipeline stages is documented with model name and description
InfoBox components are used to highlight platform constraint notes
Section is translatable via the i18n system

constraints: All AI/ML functionality remains client-side simulation — no external ML API calls
Do not modify files in frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, useActor.ts, main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui/
Backend Motoko actor in backend/main.mo is not modified unless session/profile data model changes are required
All existing panel components (BeliefStatePanel, StrategyEnginePanel, etc.) must be enhanced in place, not replaced
nonGoals: Actual integration with Whisper, BERT, RoBERTa, or any external ML service API
Real-time WebSocket streaming of ASR or NLP results
Backend changes to store individual NLP analysis results per transcript entry
Changes to the multi-language manual download feature (covered by existing requirements)

required: AI pipeline architecture diagram showing 6 stages (ASR → NLP → Emotion/Intent → Belief Modeling → Strategy Engine → Ethics) connected by arrows, dark tech aesthetic with teal accent lines on dark navy background (pipeline-diagram.dim_1200x400.png)
